source.title: A psychophysiological investigation of moral judgment after ventromedial prefrontal damage

confidence_rationale: Independent lesion cohort that both replicates the Koenigs behavioural direction and adds the missing mechanistic link: the anticipatory skin-conductance response, an EMBODIED signal, is absent in patients and correlates negatively with utilitarian endorsement in controls. The physiological measure is what lifts this above Koenigs alone for a claim whose subject is specifically EMBODIED harm sensing.
failure_signatures: The harm-avoidance signal is generated BEFORE the judgement is committed (anticipatory SCR); an architecture that consults a harm channel only after an inference has been produced would not reproduce this timing.
In patients the harmful endorsement is made with no bodily anticipatory marker at all -- the absence is silent, not experienced as a suppressed objection.

mapping.source_claim_statement: vmPFC patients approved more personal moral violations than controls and failed to generate anticipatory skin-conductance responses before endorsing them; in healthy participants the magnitude of the anticipatory SCR correlated negatively with the frequency of utilitarian judgement.
mapping.ree_translation: The harm signal that restrains a harmful-but-arguable action is (a) somatic/embodied rather than inferential and (b) emitted ANTICIPATORILY, before the judgement is committed. For ARC-103 this specifies the architecture: the harm authority is not a post-hoc filter applied to an inference engine's output but a pre-commitment signal that must be present in the decision path -- and its absence produces harmful endorsement silently, with no error raised.
mapping.mapping_caveat: SCR is a coarse, non-specific autonomic index of arousal, not a harm-specific readout; a negative correlation with utilitarian judgement in controls is correlational within that group even though the patient/control difference is lesion-driven. More importantly, REE's 'embodied harm sensing' is an engineered channel with no autonomic nervous system behind it, so the mapping borrows the FUNCTIONAL ROLE (anticipatory, non-inferential, veto-bearing) and not the physiology. The study also says nothing about symbolic or analogical inference specifically.
mapping.source_context: Human vmPFC lesion patients vs brain-damaged and healthy controls; moral-dilemma judgement with concurrent skin-conductance recording.

confidence_components.notes: Mapping fidelity set above the Koenigs entry because the anticipatory-SCR finding speaks directly to the EMBODIED and PRE-COMMITMENT properties ARC-103 asserts, rather than to affect in general. Transfer risk unchanged: still human autonomic physiology standing in for an engineered signal.
